## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk to school while discussing their classmates, including [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teases [Anne](../character/anne.md) by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and she refuses to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to leave school permanently. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay home until she cools down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) finds [Anne](../character/anne.md) weeping over imaginary future sorrow about [Diana](../character/diana.md) getting married, which sends [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) into a rare fit of laughter.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) share a tearful, romantic farewell after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne.md). Consoled by their devotion and a exchanged lock of hair, [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed back by her classmates and receives a secret note of friendship from [Diana](../character/diana.md). She dedicates herself to her studies, engaging in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while maintaining her silence toward him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

> After [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne.md) attend a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night at Diana's, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) enjoy the event together. Upon returning home, they leap into the spare-room bed as a game, unwittingly jumping directly onto Diana's visiting great-aunt, [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md). The resulting uproar leaves [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) furious and threatens Diana's music lessons, prompting a remorseful [Anne](../character/anne.md) to seek a way to make amends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Diana](../character/diana.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) a gift of dainty slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md). Later, the children perform in a successful [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert where [Anne](../character/anne.md) excels in her recitations, despite her initial nerves. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) discuss Anne's performance by the kitchen fire and consider her future education.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a restful summer outdoors per doctor's orders before resuming her studies for the upcoming [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. As the school year progresses, [Anne](../character/anne.md) matures into a quieter fifteen-year-old girl, growing taller than [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and shifting her focus to simple, disciplined writing. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a sense of loss over [Anne](../character/anne.md) growing up, while [Anne](../character/anne.md) worries about the anxiety and potential failure surrounding the crucial exams.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her school term and travels to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations. After weeks of anxious waiting, [Diana](../character/diana.md) rushes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the published results to reveal that [Anne](../character/anne.md) has tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne.md) shares the proud news with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) before ending her night with a thankful prayer.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), though leaving [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) brings emotional farewells. Upon arriving in town, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students adjust to their new environment and classes. In her boarding house room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels homesick until her schoolmates visit and share news about an upcoming Avery scholarship, sparking new academic ambitions.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has won the medal and she has won the Avery scholarship at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). After commencement, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), reunites with [Diana](../character/diana.md), and learns about Gilbert's plans and Matthew's declining health. She enjoys a peaceful day outdoors and has a tender evening conversation with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) suddenly dies from shock after reading news of the Abbey Bank failure, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) in deep grief. Neighbors come to offer support, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) gradually processes her loss through tears and conversation with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Later, as life begins to resume its normal routine, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sit together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) discussing future plans and Marilla's past relationship with John Blythe.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) continue canvassing neighbors for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), encountering an overly neat woman, odd locals, and an unhelpful household. Capitalizing on the birth of Lorenzo White's new son, [Anne](../character/anne.md) secures a generous five-dollar donation after admiring the newborn. Later that night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) attempts to canvass Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), but he refuses to contribute any money.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) drops by while [Anne](../character/anne.md) is attempting to write, and they discuss their respective teaching experiences, students, and future career ambitions. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves to get a book, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home tired and reveals that her cousin Mary Keith is dying and needs someone to care for her twin children, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) successfully persuades [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take in the twins out of a sense of duty, agreeing to help with their sewing.
>
> — v2 · VII The Pointing of Duty

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) on his porch about [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Davy's antics, and the Village Improvement Society's hall painting project. Later, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) discovers that [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) has accidentally painted the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up in color codes. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair over the blunder, but the town's sympathy ultimately turns in their favor against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who talks about church preparations, and upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learn from a letter that the twins will stay with them until fall. [Anne](../character/anne.md) recalls a humorous interaction with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) regarding his antics and misinterpretations of the catechism. Later, at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, the group is distressed to hear that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence for advertisements, and an unsuccessful committee sent to reason with him leaves them dismayed.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her school year and walks home, meeting young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) on her way to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) cemetery. They discuss their loved ones, imagination, and placing flowers on graves. At the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and the two walk home together while discussing teaching, ideals, friendship, and future plans.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

> After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns via a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle and cannot visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) sit together in the evening discussing the day's mishaps, how to replace Miss Barry's broken platter, and neighborhood gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). As they finish talking, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walks up the lane.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea, reassuring him about his imaginative thoughts and helping him feel better after a maid called him strange. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and settles his jealousy regarding [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md). Later in the evening, she encounters [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) and reflects on how much he has matured.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> After helping [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) with his evening prayers, [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) where she meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). They discuss the progress of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and their upcoming school term before [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to talk with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her plans for the next day.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> After anonymous newspaper notes predict a severe storm, an unusually devastating hailstorm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), severely damaging crops, trees, and windows. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and the twins shelter through the tempest, later learning that Mr. Harrison's parrot was killed and an eyesore house was struck by lightning. Neighbors assess the ruin, and [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md) basks in his newly acquired fame as a prophet.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

> [Diana](../character/diana.md) expresses sadness about [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaving for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her romantic feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) clarifies that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is strictly a friend and describes her idealized view of love. The two girls discuss local gossip regarding [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) before reaffirming their deep, lifelong affection for each other.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a busy month helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her upcoming wedding and discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) stumbles upon [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) professing their love for each other in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden. The next evening, [Diana](../character/diana.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to reflect on love and her own imagined future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) visit [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to help [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden in front of their guests, after which everyone sees them off at the station. While locking up the stone house afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a quiet, poignant moment that subtly alters the nature of their relationship as they look toward their college years.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) go for an afternoon walk with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) through the park and along the harbor shore. After watching the sunset from a pavilion, they walk back via [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) points out a charming, quaint house called Patty's Place. [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels an instant connection to the house and has a strong presentiment that she will become better acquainted with it.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

> After finishing term examinations at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday where she is warmly greeted by [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and the twins. That night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps a troubled [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a dilemma about wanting to say a bad word so that he feels ready to say his prayers. During the break, [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives letters from her friends, shares news with her family, and visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana.md) to air out the house and listen to the echoes once more.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) works on writing her short story, discussing characters and plot details with [Diana](../character/diana.md) and later seeking feedback from Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After completing the story, she submits it to two magazines, but receives rejections from both. Disheartened by the failures, [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to abandon her literary ambitions and put the manuscript away.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XII “Averil’s Atonement”

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for a snowbound and lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) vacation, feeling embarrassed by Gilbert's romantic attentions and worried about her finances for her next year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While conversing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and receiving letters brought by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), she worries about dropping out of college to teach. However, a letter arrives revealing that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne.md) a thousand dollars in her will, securing her financial future.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) discuss [Anne](../character/anne.md) turning twenty and her character growth. [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) joins them, showing off her dress before leaving for a dance while they chat about her suitors, including [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). After [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) departs, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) fondly ponder Phil's whimsical personality.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIX An Interlude

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a pleasant two weeks visiting [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's homestead in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) while being courted by Phil's suitors. She visits her childhood home and meets the current owner, who gives her a packet of old love letters written by her deceased parents. After visiting her parents' graves in the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to read the letters, feeling deeply connected to her mother and father at last.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends her summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) enjoying visits from friends like [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and the Irvings, though she is secretly bothered by Gilbert's absence and lack of letters. [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) deals with growing up and losing his imaginative childhood visions at the shore. Later at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) gently questions [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her disrupted relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) at Patty's Place before deciding to take a walk in the park. Catch in a sudden rainstorm, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets a handsome fellow [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) student named Royal Gardner, who rescues her with his umbrella and walks her home. Later that evening, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne.md) a dozen roses, sparking excitement and romantic speculation among her housemates.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

> While getting dressed for a [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) compliments [Anne](../character/anne.md) on her dress and mentions that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been seen frequently with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels inexplicably bothered by the news and travels to the reception with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). Upon arriving, [Anne](../character/anne.md) notices [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the room talking to the beautiful Christine and quietly compares her own appearance to hers.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside on a June evening. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) complains about his schoolwork and the local funerals, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers to help him with his arithmetic. The conversation turns to local gossip, including Diana's upcoming wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and the town's reaction to [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejecting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) later wanders down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling melancholic about Gilbert's absence and the changes that growing up brings.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana.md) prepare for her wedding at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their lifelong friendship as [Diana](../character/diana.md) nervously prepares to walk down the aisle. After the ceremony, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) escorts [Anne](../character/anne.md) home and they take a moonlight walk through Lovers' Lane. During their walk, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her plans to substitute as a teacher in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) and feels a bittersweet nostalgia for how much [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) has changed.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends reflect on what they have learned at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their examinations finish up. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne.md) chooses Gilbert's lilies over Roy's violets to carry, but later learns of a rumor about Gilbert's engagement to [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), leading her to secretly break the chain [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave her. After attending the graduation dance, the girls unwind back at Patty's Place while [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) mentions a visitor.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling a sense of disappointment and loneliness following her rejection of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She learns local gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), hears news of friends' engagements and marriages, visits Diana's new baby, and attends Phil's wedding.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and learns from her family that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. Keeping a stormy night watch in her room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) realizes she has always loved [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and despairs over her foolishness. In the morning, she meets [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote in the yard and learns that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) to go for a walk, but she must prepare for Alice Penhallow's wedding. The next afternoon, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) walk to [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes to her again.
